positions.name: NVIDIA
positions.catalyst: Multiple banks lifting PTs (consensus ~$300+) after guidance for expanded Blackwell shipments into 2H26; mgmt flags ~$1T cumulative Blackwell+Rubin demand by end-2027. Strong Buy consensus; risk-on de-escalation tape favors AI leaders.
positions.risks: FOMC Wed 6/17 macro swing; AI-capex sentiment; extended after the run.
positions.driver: AI bellwether near highs with a fresh upgrade cycle and intact data-center demand.

positions.name: Advanced Micro Devices
positions.catalyst: Citi upgrade + BofA PT to $560 on 6/12 (Venice/MI450 'Advancing AI' catalyst, top CPU pick); +130% YTD momentum, near 52w high.
positions.risks: Crowded AI long; FOMC volatility; product event (7/22-23) is weeks out so near-term driver is the analyst re-rating.
positions.driver: Highest-momentum large-cap semi with back-to-back 6/12 upgrades confirming the trend.

positions.name: Broadcom
positions.catalyst: Recovering the post-earnings (6/4) gap; reiterated >$100B AI-semi revenue runway; six custom-silicon customers (Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI). Buy consensus reaffirmed 6/13.
positions.risks: Software-segment softness flagged on the print; momentum mixed; still ~15% below the May high.
positions.driver: Quality AI custom-silicon franchise bouncing off the earnings flush with PT support.

positions.name: Goldman Sachs
positions.catalyst: New all-time high Fri 6/12; bank/value rotation persists with record Wall Street deal flow; capital-markets reacceleration.
positions.risks: FOMC rate/curve swing 6/17; capital-markets cyclicality; coarse sizing at a high share price.
positions.driver: Bulge-bracket leader breaking out as the financials rotation broadens.

positions.name: JPMorgan Chase
positions.catalyst: Near highs on the financials rotation; resilient NII and capital returns; broadening rally (equal-weight/Russell new highs) favors money-center banks.
positions.risks: FOMC 6/17 rate risk; credit-cycle concerns; broad-financial beta.
positions.driver: Highest-quality money-center bank riding the rotation into value.

positions.name: Morgan Stanley
positions.catalyst: Fresh 52w high Fri 6/12; wealth-management + IB rebound alongside GS on record deal flow.
positions.risks: Markets-revenue cyclicality; rate sensitivity into FOMC; momentum-chase.
positions.driver: Wealth/IB franchise confirming the capital-markets reacceleration with a breakout.

positions.name: GE Aerospace
positions.catalyst: Near 52w high ($348); Strong Buy consensus; aftermarket/engine demand; broadening-rally bid into industrials.
positions.risks: Rich valuation near the high; cyclical aero exposure; broad-tape beta.
positions.driver: Best-in-class aero-engine franchise with momentum into the high.

positions.name: Caterpillar
positions.catalyst: Industrials lead the 2026 rotation; CAT near 52w high ($931) on infrastructure / AI-datacenter buildout demand.
positions.risks: Cyclical/tariff exposure; high absolute level; FOMC macro.
positions.driver: Bellwether industrial riding rotation into machinery / infrastructure.

positions.name: Eaton
positions.catalyst: AI-datacenter electrification leader; momentum back toward the May high ($435); electrical-infrastructure backlog from hyperscaler power buildout.
positions.driver: Pure-play on the power/electrical side of the AI buildout with momentum re-accelerating.

positions.name: Eli Lilly
positions.catalyst: Near 52w high ($1,149); GLP-1 franchise momentum (oral orforglipron rollout); strong rebound from spring lows on raised guidance.
positions.risks: GLP-1 competitive/pricing headlines; high absolute level; single-stock event risk.
positions.driver: Mega-cap healthcare momentum leader; defensive-growth diversifier near highs.

positions.name: CarMax
positions.catalyst: FQ1 earnings Wed 6/17 BMO; options imply ~12% move; activist stake pushing digital/cost changes; beat 3 of last 4 quarters (+54.5% last surprise).
positions.risks: YoY EPS decline expected; high single-name event risk; consumer/affordability pressure.
positions.driver: High-beta earnings catalyst with activist support and positive pre-positioning.

positions.name: Kroger
positions.catalyst: FQ1 earnings Thu 6/18 BMO; defensive staple with steady buybacks; idiosyncratic earnings catalyst plus low-beta ballast into FOMC.
positions.risks: Soft recent share trend; grocery-margin/competition; guidance-driven.
positions.driver: Defensive earnings catalyst offering ballast against the week's macro (FOMC) risk.
